title: Add BIST-ITCH Dissector
description:
Adds a dissector for BIST TotalView-ITCH protocol used by Borsa Istanbul.
- Supports major message types: Add Order, Trade, Executed, Delete, etc.
- Integrated with MoldUDP64
- Licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later
- Included in build system (CMakeLists.txt)
- Documented in Wireshark_Release_Notes.adoc
